profile.name: Waldi Bahy Hanif Ramadhani
profile.headline: Machine Learning & AI Engineer
about: ML / AI engineering student at Universitas Teknologi Yogyakarta. I learn by building smaller versions of the things I read about, then breaking them until they work.
I care about what happens after training: datasets that don't need babysitting, APIs that behave, and pipelines that run the same on my laptop and on the server.
Deep in LLM apps, agent workflows, and computer vision — mostly late at night, with way too many print statements.

research.narrative: My work is practical first: train the model, load it, serve it, watch it fail, fix it, ship it. I read papers and rebuild them badly at first — the fastest way I know to actually understand them. Lately that means agentic systems that use tools instead of just agreeing with you.
